messages.subject: Problem with changing reactiveValues
parts:
Hi,

I have a problem with my code, as I am not able to make reactiveValues to "remeber" values. 

In my code below, after I set value for A to for example 50 and then switch letter to B it automatically gets 50 (while in reactiveValues object, where I storage values for all letters, it has 0). 

How can I update my code, so that all letters have assigned numbers and after switching letter in selectInput, sliderInput value is updated to the value, that letter has in reactiveValues.

I would be very grateful, if someone told me, what am I doing wrong. :(

========= ui.R
shinyUI(
  pageWithSidebar(               
      headerPanel(""),
      sidebarPanel(
          selectInput("letter","Select",choices=list("A","B","C"),selected="A"),
          uiOutput("x.UI")
          ),
      mainPanel(                 
          tableOutput("x.tab")
          )
    )
)

=========server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) { 

x<-reactiveValues()

x.Update<-function(){
  
    if(length(reactiveValuesToList(x))==0){
    x$A<-x$B<-x$C<-0
    }
  if(input[["x.slider"]]!=reactiveValuesToList(x)[[input$letter]]){
    
    x[[input$letter]]<-reactiveValuesToList(input)[["x.slider"]]
    
  }
  
}

output$x.tab<-reactiveTable(function(){
  
  x.Update()
  
  as.data.frame(reactiveValuesToList(x))
  
}) 

output$x.UI<-reactiveUI(function(){
  
  val<-get(input$letter,pos=reactiveValuesToList(x))
  
  sliderInput("x.slider", "Select", 
              min=0, max=500, value=1, step= 1)
  
})

})
